title.purpose: Uppercase, wide-tracked section labels and form legends.

label.purpose: Field labels, badges, nav item text.

stat.purpose: All numeric scouting data — scores, ranks, team IDs, EPA. Never used for prose.

motion.name: queue-blink
motion.purpose: Hard on/off flash for the Pit Dashboard's <5-minute queue alert. The only animated element in the system; no fade, no easing.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #7a1a24; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #5e141c; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c04a56; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Toggle Button (Alliance Picker)
components.description: Selectable toggle, e.g. Red/Blue alliance choice — selected state fills solid like a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-toggle { background: #ffffff; color: #33373a; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #d5d7d9; border-radius: 6px; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-toggle:hover { border-color: #b3b7bb; } .ds-btn-toggle[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #7a1a24; border-color: #7a1a24; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text/number field used across scouting forms.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #ffffff; color: #17181a; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #d5d7d9; border-radius: 6px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #c04a56; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f5d0d3; }

components.name: Stat Number
components.description: The Telemetry Rule in practice — any numeric scouting value (score, rank, team ID).

components.name: Card / List Container
components.description: Standard bordered container for recent submissions, assignment lists, etc.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d5d7d9; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-card-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-card-row + .ds-card-row { border-top: 1px solid #eceded; }

components.name: Desktop Tab
components.description: Top nav tab, active state gets a maroon underline.
components.css: .ds-tab { display: inline-block; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #5f6569; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #17181a; } .ds-tab-active { color: #5e141c; border-bottom-color: #7a1a24; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Success/error inline status message, e.g. after a form submit.
components.html: Submitted — form reset for the next match.
components.css: .ds-badge { border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-badge-success { background: #d9f0e1; color: #15803d; } .ds-badge-error { background: #fbeced; color: #5e141c; }

narrative.overview: This is a field-ops console, not a dashboard demo — built to be thumbed through in a loud, bright convention-center pit and reviewed carefully on a laptop the night before eliminations. The system is deliberately unglamorous where glamour would slow someone down: flat surfaces, hard borders, no shadows to squint through, numbers set in monospace so a column of match scores reads like telemetry instead of prose. Maroon and white — Team 5806's colors — carry the team's identity and confidence, appearing at full saturation only where it means something (a primary action, an active tab, the header) rather than washing across every surface. The lion shows up as attitude, not as illustration: sharp corners are avoided in favor of small, consistent radii; the tone is direct and declarative rather than playful.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, bordered surfaces — no drop shadows anywhere in the system
Maroon reserved for action and emphasis; graphite carries the everyday chrome
Numeric data (scores, ranks, EPA, match numbers) always renders in monospace
Small, consistent corner radii (6–8px) — nothing sharp, nothing soft-rounded
Contrast pushed generously above AA-minimum for high-glare outdoor/convention-hall readability

rules.name: The Reserved Maroon Rule
rules.body: Maroon is for things the user should do or that are currently active — a primary button, an active tab, a required marker. It never fills a background or a card.

rules.name: The Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Any number that represents scouting data renders in Geist Mono via the font-stat token. Prose and UI labels never do.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow anywhere in the system. Depth comes from a 1px graphite-200 border and a white-on-warm-white contrast step.

dos: Do reserve maroon-600/maroon-700 for actions and active states only
Do render every scouting number in Geist Mono via the Stat token
Do use a 1px graphite-200 border as the only depth cue — no shadows, ever
Do keep tap targets large (44px minimum) and contrast generous
Do keep corner radii small and consistent (6–8px)
donts: Don't build a generic consumer-SaaS look — no soft gradients, no cute illustrations, no cream/pastel backgrounds
Don't let maroon fill a background or a card
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, or side-stripe colored borders
Don't animate anything beyond the queue-blink alert without a strong reason
